game.title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
game.blurb: Action platformer in which a warrior uses Time Powers, combat and platforming to explore the cursed, Persian-inspired Mount Qaf, published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2024-01-18. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey through Mount Qaf and its bosses. Spoiler-guarded; the story achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Upgrades and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Necklace, sword and bow upgrades, amulets, Soma Tree petals, ores and Time Crystals.

chapters.title: Exploration and Side Quests
chapters.summary: The prophecy fresco, the Wak-Wak heads and every side quest.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Athra Surges, opportunity attacks, aerial kills, spike traps and Lost Warriors.

chapters.title: Mask of Darkness (add-on)
chapters.summary: The Mask of Darkness content: memory fragments, sentinels, Soma Tree flowers, amulets and its own bosses.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2751000)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Prince_of_Persia:_The_Lost_Crown
Fandom (princeofpersia.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://princeofpersia.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_of_Persia:_The_Lost_Crown
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG lists no developer for this game, only the publisher Ubisoft Entertainment; both StrategyWiki and Fandom link a page named "Ubisoft Montpellier" from the game page, but the data does not say it is the developer. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0 (a stub); only a short Table of Contents subpage (570 characters) exists, and its Walkthrough, Amulets, Controls, Gameplay and Achievements and trophies pages are linked but not written. princeofpersia.fandom.com answers the API, with about 76 linked pages, including "Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness", "Mount Qaf" and "Immortals"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Memory" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2751000 as "Prince of Persia The Lost Crown". 19 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden; the ones in 1 to 21 sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Achievements 36 and 37 name Mask of Darkness; the block they sit in (30 to 40, including the hidden "The Dead Die Twice", "Remember Me/You/Us" and "Broken Mask", plus memory fragments, sentinels, the Saw Bird and the undead master) was put in the Mask of Darkness chapter by position, which needs checking. RAWG also has a second entry ("prince-of-persia-the-lost-crown-2", 2024-08-08); the expected entry (id 962011) was used.
